snippet.title: Dreadlines - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
One unemployed morning, an email lands in your inbox: a start date and a company you have never heard of. No interview. No job title. Just Charon Logistics, and the creeping sense that they already know a great deal more about you than you know about them.

Dreadlines is a monster office dating sim about connections, deadlines and falling for your undead coworkers. Answer emails, survive small talk and try not to dwell on the fact that you might be the only person in the building with a pulse.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146570/Dreadlines/

Developer: Zimt Games
